questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: At timestamp 00:09, the board is fully visible and clearly holds three pens in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with their caps pointing towards the bottom of the frame.
The leftmost pen has a blue barrel/ink, while the middle and rightmost pens have black barrels/ink.
All pens appear to have caps on the bottom end and are of similar length.
The board moves continuously from left to right without stopping or jamming throughout the clip.
The pens remain stationary relative to the white board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The video shows an anomaly because the leftmost pen is blue while the other two pens are black, violating the requirement that all pens must share the same color.

description: One pen differs in color from the other two.
